Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are about to attempt a Recall Knowledge check

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. Attempt the triggering Recall Knowledge check with legendary proficiency and your Intelligence modifier, regardless of the skill it would normally use and regardless of your proficiency in that skill. You are not consulting your own memory; you are consulting the Archive's, and it files everything the same way.
